body:
Self-contained specification for Orchestrator frontier builder routing, per-slug builder-fault circuit breaker, and v1.3.0 documentation (ZERO edits to frozen `lib/pools.mjs`).

IMPORTANT HEADLESS WORKER SHELL RULE: In this headless worker session, `PreToolUse` allows ONLY `node --test <files>` and `npm test` (plus pure read commands `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `grep`, `ls`, `wc`, `git status`, `git diff`). Do NOT run `npm run build`, `node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs`, `node -e`, or edit `dist/**` / `website/generated/**` (those generated directories are out of scope and refreshed post-wave).

1. `lib/models.mjs`:
   - Update `TIER_CANDIDATES.frontier` to:
     `Object.freeze(['gemini-pro-orchestrator', 'claude-sonnet-5-5-high', 'gemini-pro-orchestrator-argon', 'gemini-4-argon-high', 'gemini-4-carbon-high', 'claude-opus-5-5-high'])`.
   - Export `FRONTIER_NO_ORCHESTRATOR = Object.freeze(['gemini-4-argon-high', 'claude-sonnet-5-5-high', 'gemini-4-carbon-high', 'claude-opus-5-5-high'])`.
   - Keep Orchestrator slugs strictly excluded from `TIER_CANDIDATES.cheap`, `TIER_CANDIDATES.mid`, `PROSECUTORS`, `PROSECUTOR_CANDIDATES`, and `ROLE_MODELS`. Ensure `poolOf()` prefix fallback maps `'hydrogen-*'` / `'gemini-4-hydrogen-*'` to `'gemini-pro'`.
   - Export `setOrchestratorRoutingState({ disableOrchestrator = false, disabledModels = null } = {})` and `resetOrchestratorRoutingState()`. Normalize `disabledModels` inside BOTH `setOrchestratorRoutingState` and `tierCandidates(tier = 'mid', poolHint, options)` via `toModelSet(v)` (`v instanceof Set ? v : (Array.isArray(v) ? new Set(v) : null)`) so callers may pass `Set`, `Array`, or `null`.
   - In `tierCandidates(tier = 'mid', poolHint, options)`: base list for `'frontier'` is `disableOrchestrator ? FRONTIER_NO_ORCHESTRATOR : TIER_CANDIDATES.frontier` (where `disableOrchestrator = Boolean(options?.disableOrchestrator ?? runtimeState.disableOrchestrator) || process.env.AGB_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATOR === '1'`), filtered by `poolHint` and `!(disabledSet && disabledSet.has(m))`.

2. `lib/status.mjs` & `lib/scheduler.mjs`:
   - In `RunStatus` (`lib/status.mjs`), add `statsContext: null`, `modelStats: {}`, and `disabledModels: []` to `this.state`, plus `initModelStats(statsContext, priorState)` (restoring `modelStats` and returning `new Set(priorState.disabledModels)` from prior `.booster/run.json` **only if** `priorState?.statsContext?.planHash === statsContext.planHash && priorState?.statsContext?.agyVersion === statsContext.agyVersion`, else resetting to `{}` and returning `new Set()`) and `updateModelStats(modelSlug, { resolved = false, builderFault = false, merged = false, rateLimited = false, disabledModels } = {})`.
   - In `lib/scheduler.mjs`, import `{ lt as semverLt } from './semver.mjs'` and `createHash` from `'node:crypto'`:
     1. Run `checkAgyBinary({ env: process.env })` before routing; compute `agyVersion = agyCheck.version ?? null` and deterministic `planHash` via `createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify([...tickets].sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id)).map((t) => ({ id: t.id, scope: [...(t.scope ?? [])].sort(), edges: [...(t.edges ?? [])].map((e) => e.to).sort() })))).digest('hex')`.
     2. Set `disableOrchestrator = Boolean(plan.disableOrchestrator) || process.env.AGB_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATOR === '1' || Boolean(agyVersion && semverLt(agyVersion, '1.5.9'))`; when `agyVersion && semverLt(agyVersion, '1.5.9')`, log `[agb] notice: agy ${agyVersion} < 1.5.9; Orchestrator slugs auto-disabled`.
     3. Read prior `.booster/run.json` (if present before `new RunStatus`) into `const disabledModels = status.initModelStats({ planHash, agyVersion }, priorRunJson)` and call `setOrchestratorRoutingState({ disableOrchestrator, disabledModels })` (calling `resetOrchestratorRoutingState()` in `runPlan`'s `finally`). Ensure initial ticket routing (`pools.route`) runs AFTER `setOrchestratorRoutingState`, and update routing state whenever `disabledModels` mutates.
     4. Implement **per-ticket, per-slug, builder-fault-only accounting**:
        - Per `modelSlug`: `{ resolvedTickets: number, builderFaultTickets: number, mergedTickets: number, rateLimits: number }`.
        - `model_unavailable` -> add `modelSlug` immediately to `disabledModels` (`0` strikes, `0` `resolvedTickets` increment).
        - `build.rateLimited === true` -> increment `rateLimits += 1` only.
        - Ticket merges on `modelSlug` -> `resolvedTickets += 1`, `mergedTickets += 1`.
        - Builder execution fault (`!build.ok` with non-rate-limit, non-`model_unavailable` `kind`, OR `empty_diff` anti-no-op, counted **at most once per `(ticketId, modelSlug)` pair**) -> `resolvedTickets += 1`, `builderFaultTickets += 1`.
        - Gate/test failure (`!gates.ok`) or prosecutor rejection (`verdict === 'block'`) when ticket finishes on `modelSlug` without a builder execution fault -> `resolvedTickets += 1` ONLY (`builderFaultTickets` NOT incremented!).
        - **Per-slug breaker:** when `(modelSlug === 'gemini-pro-orchestrator' || modelSlug === 'gemini-pro-orchestrator-argon') && stats.resolvedTickets >= 4 && stats.builderFaultTickets / stats.resolvedTickets >= 0.5`, log `[agb] warning: demoting ${modelSlug} ...` and add **only that `modelSlug`** to `disabledModels`!

3. Tests & Docs:
   - Update `test/models-live-catalog.test.mjs`, `test/models-registry.test.mjs`, and `test/pools.test.mjs` for `TIER_CANDIDATES.frontier` (`frontier+gemini` = `4`, `cheap`/`mid`/`PROSECUTORS`/`PROSECUTOR_CANDIDATES`/`ROLE_MODELS` exclude `orchestrator`).
   - Create `test/orchestrator-routing.test.mjs` verifying: (a) `PoolSet.route('frontier', 'auto')` `4+4` at `4/4`, `2+4` at `2/4`, and `FRONTIER_NO_ORCHESTRATOR` under `AGB_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATOR=1`, `plan.disableOrchestrator: true`, and `agy 1.5.8` / `1.5.9-rc.1`, plus `Set` & `Array` `disabledModels`; (b) per-slug breaker (`!gates.ok` 4x -> `builderFaultTickets === 0`; 2/4 builder faults -> demotes only `gemini-pro-orchestrator` while `gemini-pro-orchestrator-argon` stays active; `agyVersion`/`planHash` change resets `modelStats`); (c) 4-Claude Promise-barrier `gpt-oss-120b-medium` prosecutor FIFO test (`0` deadlocks) + `poolOf('hydrogen-custom') === 'gemini-pro'`; (d) read-only 60-tool completeness check against `test/fixtures/agy-1.5.9-init-tools.json` (`decision === 'pass' || decision === 'deny'`, never `'ask'`).
   - Update `test/live/hooks.live.test.mjs` (`skip` unless `AGB_LIVE_AGY=1`) to assert live `init.tools` matches `test/fixtures/agy-1.5.9-init-tools.json` and run a live `gemini-pro-orchestrator` smoke turn.
   - Update `USAGE.md`, `docs/guidelines.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md` for v1.3.0.
   - Verify with `node --test test/orchestrator-routing.test.mjs test/models-live-catalog.test.mjs test/models-registry.test.mjs test/pools.test.mjs` and finish cleanly.
title: Enable flag-, version-, and per-slug breaker-guarded Orchestrator frontier routing
